title: A Causal Inference Framework for Climate Change Attribution in Ecology
abstract: As climate change increasingly affects biodiversity and ecosystem services, a key challenge in ecology is accurate attribution of these impacts. Though experimental studies have greatly advanced our understanding of climate change effects, experimental results are difficult to generalise to real‐world scenarios. To better capture realised impacts, ecologists can use observational data. Disentangling cause and effect using observational data, however, requires careful research design. Here we describe advances in causal inference that can improve climate change attribution in observational settings. Our framework includes five steps: (1) describe the theoretical foundation, (2) choose appropriate observational datasets, (3) estimate the causal relationships of interest, (4) simulate a counterfactual scenario and (5) evaluate results and assumptions using robustness checks. We demonstrate this framework using a pinyon pine case study in North America, and we conclude with a discussion of frontiers in climate change attribution. Our aim is to provide an accessible foundation for applying observational causal inference to estimate climate change effects on ecological systems.
abstract_zh: 随着气候变化对生物多样性和生态系统服务的影响日益加深，生态学面临的一个关键挑战是准确归因这些影响。尽管实验研究极大地增进了我们对气候变化效应的理解，但实验结果难以推广到现实世界的情境中。为了更好地刻画已实现的影响，生态学家可以利用观测数据。然而，利用观测数据厘清因果关系需要审慎的研究设计。本文介绍了能够改进观测情境下气候变化归因的因果推断进展。我们的框架包括五个步骤：（1）阐述理论基础，（2）选择合适的观测数据集，（3）估计感兴趣的因果关系，（4）模拟反事实情景，（5）利用稳健性检验评估结果和假设。我们以北美的松子（pinyon pine）案例研究展示了该框架，并在最后讨论了气候变化归因的前沿问题。我们的目的是为在观测数据中应用因果推断、估计气候变化对生态系统的影响，提供一个易于理解的基础。

title: Triangulating Habitat Suitability for the Locally Extirpated California Grizzly Bear
Uneven participation of independent and contract smallholders in certified palm oil mill markets in Indonesia
abstract: Sustainability requirements imposed on agricultural producers by downstream supply chain actors risk excluding smallholder farmers from upgraded markets. Here we investigated smallholder participation in sustainably certified palm oil mill markets in Indonesia. We developed and applied a conceptual model to estimate the importance of structural market access, smallholder capacity, and buyer/seller behavior in shaping mill smallholder sourcing. Smallholders who hold exclusive contracts with specific mills were overrepresented at certified mills. Independent smallholders unaffiliated with mills contributed one-third of regional oil palm production but 7% of certified mill supply. We found no evidence that independent smallholders exited markets after mill certification (“active” exclusion). Instead, only 36% of certified mills ever purchased from independent smallholders, and independent smallholder lands were less common around certified (29–38% of palm area) versus noncertified (41–42%) mills. To address such “passive” exclusion, supply chain governance programs should encourage participation of actors well-positioned to source from small-scale producers.
abstract_zh: 下游供应链主体对农业生产者提出的可持续性要求，可能使小农被排除在升级后的市场之外。本文考察了印度尼西亚经可持续认证的棕榈油加工厂市场中小农的参与情况。我们构建并应用了一个概念模型，用以估计结构性市场准入、小农能力以及买卖双方行为在塑造加工厂小农采购方面的相对重要性。与特定加工厂签订独家合同的小农，在经认证的加工厂中占比过高。与加工厂没有关联的独立小农贡献了区域油棕产量的三分之一，但仅占经认证加工厂供应量的7%。我们没有发现证据表明，独立小农在加工厂获得认证后退出了市场（“主动”排斥）。相反，只有36%的经认证加工厂曾向独立小农采购，而且与未经认证的加工厂（41%–42%的油棕种植面积）相比，经认证加工厂周边的独立小农土地所占比例更低（29%–38%的油棕种植面积）。为应对此类“被动”排斥，供应链治理项目应鼓励那些具备优势、能够从小规模生产者处采购的主体参与进来。

title: Chilean payments for forest restoration achieved greater environmental impacts when directed toward economically disadvantaged groups
Environmental Impacts of Indigenous Land Restitution in Chile
Improving Smallholder Representation in Crop Maps
abstract: Farms smaller than five hectares produce more than half of the world’s crops. Accurate maps of smallholder croplands thus hold great potential to inform a wide variety of policies including those that aim to address food insecurity, provide agricultural support, or encourage adaptation to climate change. However, many remotely sensed maps of croplands have been developed in ways that preferentially identify large, intensively managed fields. Here, we illustrate how remotely-sensed land cover maps could be improved to yield better information about smallholder farming, using Paraguay as a study system. We show that prior land cover maps dramatically underestimate smallholder croplands in Paraguay due to misclassification of these systems as a mixture of pastures, shrublands and forests. These maps fail to classify 55%–99% of smallholder fields ( < 5 ha) as croplands, overlooking more than 50–120 thousand farmers (or 16%–43% of the farming population) in the country. We develop national-scale land cover maps that more accurately identify smallholder croplands, conducting a series of experiments to identify specific methodological practices that enable the greatest improvements in smallholder cropland mapping. We show that modest adjustments to the training sample can improve smallholder crop recall in Paraguay by more than 27 percentage points compared to the best performing existing crop map, while other modeling adjustments, such as field segmentation and improved spatial resolution, improve smallholder crop recall by an additional 8 percentage points. Our analysis underscores the need for remote sensing scientists to more carefully consider crop system heterogeneity and to ensure that all farming systems are represented in training data for crop mapping.
abstract_zh: 经营面积小于5公顷的农场生产了全球一半以上的农作物。因此，准确的小农耕地地图在为各类政策提供信息方面具有巨大潜力，这些政策包括旨在应对粮食不安全、提供农业支持或促进气候变化适应的政策。然而，许多基于遥感的耕地地图在绘制过程中，偏向于识别大型、集约化经营的田块。本文以巴拉圭为研究案例，说明了如何改进基于遥感的土地覆盖地图，以获得关于小农农业的更好信息。我们发现，既有的土地覆盖地图严重低估了巴拉圭的小农耕地，原因是这些系统被误分类为牧场、灌丛和森林的混合体。这些地图未能将55%–99%的小农田块（面积小于5公顷）识别为耕地，使该国超过5万至12万户农民（即农业人口的16%–43%）被忽视。我们开发了全国尺度的土地覆盖地图，以更准确地识别小农耕地，并开展了一系列实验，以确定能够最大程度改善小农耕地制图的具体方法实践。我们发现，对训练样本做适度调整，即可使巴拉圭小农作物的召回率较表现最好的现有作物图提高27个百分点以上；而其他建模调整，例如田块分割和提高空间分辨率，还能使小农作物召回率再提高8个百分点。我们的分析表明，遥感科学家需要更加审慎地考虑作物系统的异质性，并确保训练数据涵盖所有农业系统，以用于作物制图。

title: Indonesia's Pulp Sector Risks Reversing Progress towards Zero Deforestation
Who benefits from individual rights over indigenous lands? Evidence from the Mapuche
Zero-Deforestation Commitments in Indonesia's Palm Oil Sector Achieve High Compliance but No Additionality
abstract: In response to public pressure, companies have increasingly adopted voluntary sustainable sourcing commitments. Yet, it often remains unclear whether such commitments lead only to the narrow goal of supplier compliance, or also to the broader goal of additionality, benefits beyond what would have occurred without commitments. A company’s ability to influence its suppliers’ behavior partly depends on the complexity of supply chains, yet data on supply chain linkages are limited, inhibiting causal evaluations. Here, we evaluate the compliance and additionality of zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs) in the Indonesian palm oil sector, a major driver of tropical deforestation. We compiled a detailed dataset that integrates information about corporate ZDC implementation, supply chain linkages, and maps of palm-driven deforestation in Indonesia. We use this dataset to evaluate the causal impact of ZDCs on deforestation in oil palm concessions from 2018 to 2020 using difference-in-differences econometric methods. We find that concessions linked to companies with ZDCs had low deforestation (<1% per year from 2018 to 2020) and thus largely achieved compliance. Yet they experienced similar reductions in deforestation compared to concessions not covered by ZDCs, therefore showing no additionality. We attribute our finding of no additionality to broader changes in policy and economic conditions during the study period that may have reduced the remaining accessible forest and dampened market and regulatory incentives to clear forests for palm oil. Should these conditions change in the future, continued compliance with ZDCs could yield additional reductions in deforestation.
abstract_zh: 在公众压力之下，企业越来越多地采纳自愿性的可持续采购承诺。然而，这类承诺是否只实现了供应商合规这一狭义目标，还是也实现了更广泛的额外性目标（即超出无承诺情形下本会发生的效益），往往仍不清楚。企业影响其供应商行为的能力，部分取决于供应链的复杂程度，而有关供应链联系的数据十分有限，这妨碍了因果评估。本文评估了印度尼西亚棕榈油行业零毁林承诺（ZDCs）的合规性和额外性，该行业是热带毁林的主要驱动因素之一。我们编制了一个详细的数据集，整合了企业零毁林承诺的落实信息、供应链联系，以及印度尼西亚由棕榈油驱动的毁林地图。我们利用该数据集，采用双重差分计量方法，评估了2018至2020年间零毁林承诺对油棕特许经营地毁林的因果影响。我们发现，与零毁林承诺企业存在供应关系的特许经营地毁林率较低（2018至2020年每年低于1%），因此在很大程度上实现了合规。然而，与未被零毁林承诺覆盖的特许经营地相比，它们的毁林减少幅度相似，因此并未体现出额外性。我们将无额外性的发现归因于研究期间政策和经济条件的更广泛变化，这些变化可能减少了可砍伐森林的剩余可及面积，并削弱了清除森林以生产棕榈油的市场和监管激励。如果这些条件在未来发生变化，持续遵守零毁林承诺或许能带来额外的毁林减少。

title: Global Governance through Voluntary Sustainability Standards: Developments, Trends and Challenges
abstract: Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS) are transnational governance instruments that can be leveraged to pursue sustainable development in global value chains. They have proliferated since the 1990s in terms of their number and the share of global production they govern. This paper shares some key insights arising from the considerable body of literature that has analysed the role of these instruments for sustainable production and trade. First, it introduces VSS, traces the evolution of their adoption and takes stock of the research on their sustainability impacts. Next, some major developments in the VSS realm are discussed, related to public policy and the emergence of national sustainability standards. The paper then zooms in on the challenges and limitations of VSS in transforming value chains towards sustainability, focusing on the shortcomings related to inclusiveness and the problems arising from their proliferation. The paper concludes by distilling recommendations on overcoming these challenges, especially in light of recent policy developments, and outlines what different stakeholders can do to make VSS more effective and inclusive instruments for sustainable value chains.
abstract_zh: 自愿性可持续标准（VSS）是跨国治理工具，可用于在全球价值链中推动可持续发展。自20世纪90年代以来，它们在数量以及所管辖的全球生产份额方面都迅速增长。本文梳理了大量分析这些工具在可持续生产和贸易中作用的文献，并分享其中的一些关键见解。首先，本文介绍了自愿性可持续标准，梳理其采纳的演变过程，并对其可持续性影响的研究进行了总结。接着，本文讨论了与公共政策以及国家可持续标准的兴起相关的该领域若干重要进展。随后，本文聚焦于自愿性可持续标准在推动价值链迈向可持续方面所面临的挑战和局限，重点关注其在包容性方面的不足，以及其数量激增所带来的问题。最后，本文基于近期的政策发展，提出了克服这些挑战的建议，并概述了不同利益相关方可以采取哪些行动，使自愿性可持续标准成为更有效、更包容的可持续价值链工具。

title: How Well Does the Implementation of Corporate Zero-Deforestation Commitments in Indonesia Align with Aims to Halt Deforestation and Include Smallholders?
abstract: In response to growing scrutiny surrounding commodity-driven deforestation, companies have introduced zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs) with ambitious environmental and social targets. However, such initiatives may not effectively reduce deforestation if they are not aligned with the spatial extent of remaining forests at risk. They may also fail to avert socio-economic risks if ZDCs do not consider smallholder farmers’ needs. We assess the spatial and functional fit of ZDCs by mapping commodity-driven deforestation and socio-economic risks, and comparing them to the spatial coverage and implementation of ZDCs in the Indonesian palm oil sector. Our study finds that companies’ ZDCs often underperform in four areas: traceability, compliance support for high-risk palm oil mills, transparency, and smallholder inclusion. In 2020, only one-third of companies sourcing from their own mills, and just 6% of those sourcing from external suppliers, achieved full traceability to plantations. Comparing the reach of ZDCs adopted by downstream buyers with those adopted by mill owners located further upstream, we find that high-quality ZDCs from buyers covered 62% of forests at risk, while mill owners’ ZDCs only covered 23% of forests at risk within the mill supply base. In Kalimantan and Papua, the current and future deforestation frontiers, the forests most at risk of conversion were predominantly covered by weak ZDCs lacking in policy comprehensiveness and implementation. Additionally, we find that only 46% of independent smallholder oil palm plots are in mill supply sheds whose owners offer programs and support for independent smallholders, indicating that smallholder inclusion is a significant challenge for ZDC companies. These results highlight the lack of spatial and functional alignment between supply chain policies and their local context as a significant gap in ZDC implementation and a challenge that the EU Deforestation Regulation will face.
abstract_zh: 在对大宗商品驱动的毁林问题日益严格审视的背景下，企业推出了零毁林承诺（ZDCs），并设定了雄心勃勃的环境和社会目标。然而，如果这些举措与仍面临风险的剩余森林的空间范围不相匹配，就可能无法有效减少毁林。如果零毁林承诺没有考虑小农的需求，它们也可能无法避免社会经济风险。我们通过绘制大宗商品驱动的毁林和社会经济风险的地图，并将其与印度尼西亚棕榈油行业零毁林承诺的空间覆盖范围和实施情况进行比较，以评估零毁林承诺在空间和功能上的契合度。我们的研究发现，企业的零毁林承诺在四个方面往往表现不佳：可追溯性、对高风险棕榈油加工厂的合规支持、透明度以及小农纳入。2020年，只有三分之一自有加工厂采购的企业，以及仅6%从外部供应商采购的企业，实现了对种植园的完全可追溯。比较下游买家采纳的零毁林承诺与位于上游的加工厂所有者采纳的承诺的覆盖范围，我们发现，高质量的买家零毁林承诺覆盖了62%面临风险的森林，而加工厂所有者的零毁林承诺仅覆盖了其加工厂供应基地内23%面临风险的森林。在当前和未来的毁林前沿加里曼丹和巴布亚，最容易被转为他用的森林，主要被缺乏政策全面性和执行力的薄弱零毁林承诺所覆盖。此外，我们发现，只有46%的独立小农油棕地块位于其所有者为独立小农提供项目和支持的加工厂供应区内，这表明小农纳入是零毁林承诺企业面临的一大挑战。这些结果表明，供应链政策与其当地背景在空间和功能上缺乏契合，这是零毁林承诺实施中的一个重大缺口，也是欧盟《反毁林条例》将面临的挑战。

title: Impact Evaluation with Nonrepeatable Outcomes: The Case of Forest Conservation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The application of quasiexperimental impact evaluation to remotely sensed measures of deforestation has yielded important evidence detailing the effectiveness of conservation policies. However, researchers have paid insufficient attention to the binary and nonrepeatable structure of most deforestation datasets. Using analytical proofs and simulations, we demonstrate that many commonly employed econometric approaches are biased when applied to binary and nonrepeatable outcomes. The significance, magnitude and even direction of estimated effects from many studies are likely incorrect, threatening to undermine the evidence base that underpins conservation policy adoption and design. To address these concerns, we provide guidance and new strategies for the design of panel econometric models that yield more reliable estimates of the impacts of forest conservation policies.
abstract_zh: 准实验性的影响评估方法已被应用于遥感测量的毁林数据，并揭示了保护政策有效性的重要证据。然而，研究者对大多数毁林数据集所具有的二元性和不可重复结构关注不足。通过解析证明和模拟，我们表明，许多常用的计量经济学方法在应用于二元且不可重复的结果变量时存在偏误。许多研究所估计效应的显著性、大小乃至方向都可能是错误的，这可能动摇支撑保护政策制定与设计的证据基础。为解决这些问题，我们为面板计量模型的设计提供了指导和新的策略，以便得出更可靠的森林保护政策影响估计。

title: Leveraging Remote Sensing for Transparency and Accountability in Amazonian Commodity Supply Chains
Smallholder Participation in Zero-Deforestation Supply Chain Initiatives in the Indonesian Palm Oil Sector: Challenges, Opportunities, and Limitations
abstract: As actors in tropical agricultural commodity supply chains implement commitments to end deforestation, they risk exacerbating social inequities by excluding smallholder farmers, who are important producers of many tropical commodity crops. Here, we explore the potential for independent oil palm smallholders in Indonesia to participate in zero-deforestation supply chains. We find that these smallholders are underrepresented in the share of zero-deforestation compliant oil palm production. We then synthesize perspectives from key actors in the oil palm industry including smallholders and their representatives, palm oil producing and consulting companies, nongovernmental organizations, and academic researchers. Based on these perspectives, we find that challenges to smallholder supply chain participation include limitations in knowledge (e.g., smallholders may not know the location of protected forests), institutional issues (e.g., absence of trust between oil palm growing companies and smallholder farmers), and financial constraints (e.g., the opportunity cost of not clearing forest). To address these shortcomings, we encourage oil palm growing and milling companies to take the lead on incentivizing, supporting, and facilitating smallholder participation in zero-deforestation initiatives. Specifically, these companies could build and use their technical and political resources to identify and map all forests in their entire supply shed and ensure small producers have land rights that enable participation in zero-deforestation supply chains. These policy levers would need to be combined with economic incentives such as access to improved inputs or price premia for their products. However, we caution that smallholder integration into existing zero-deforestation supply chains alone is unlikely to result in significant additional forest conservation at scale in Indonesia due to selection bias, leakage, and existing land tenure norms. Community-led and jurisdictional or landscape-scale supply chain initiatives that acknowledge multi-commodity production are more likely to provide equitable and just avenues for Indonesian smallholder farmers to steward forest resources.
abstract_zh: 热带农产品供应链的参与者在落实终止毁林的承诺时，可能因排斥小农而加剧社会不平等，而小农恰恰是许多热带经济作物的重要生产者。本文探讨了印度尼西亚独立油棕小农参与零毁林供应链的潜力。我们发现，这些小农在符合零毁林标准的油棕产量中所占份额偏低。随后，我们综合了油棕行业主要利益相关方的观点，包括小农及其代表、棕榈油生产企业和咨询公司、非政府组织以及学术研究人员。基于这些观点，我们发现小农参与供应链面临的挑战包括：知识方面的局限（例如，小农可能不知道保护林的位置）、制度方面的问题（例如，油棕种植企业与小农之间缺乏信任），以及财务约束（例如，不砍伐森林的机会成本）。为弥补这些不足，我们鼓励油棕种植和加工企业带头激励、支持并促进小农参与零毁林倡议。具体而言，这些企业可以利用其技术和政治资源，识别并绘制其整个供应区内的所有森林，并确保小规模生产者拥有能够参与零毁林供应链的土地权利。这些政策杠杆还需与经济激励相结合，例如获得改良投入品或获得产品价格溢价。然而，我们提醒，由于选择偏误、泄漏以及现有的土地权属规范，仅靠将小农纳入现有的零毁林供应链，不太可能在印度尼西亚大规模地实现显著的额外森林保护。承认多种商品共同生产的社区主导型以及辖区或景观尺度的供应链倡议，更有可能为印度尼西亚小农守护森林资源提供公平、公正的途径。

title: Spillovers to Manufacturing Plants from Multi-Million Dollar Plantations: Evidence from the Indonesian Palm Oil Boom
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Addressing indirect sourcing in zero deforestation supply chains
abstract: The trade in agricultural commodities is a backbone of the global economy but is a major cause of negative social and environmental impacts, not least deforestation. Commodity traders are key actors in efforts to eliminate deforestation—they are active in the regions where commodities are produced and represent a “pinch point” in global trade that provides a powerful lever for change. However, the procurement strategies of traders remain opaque. Here, we catalog traders’ sourcing across four sectors with high rates of commodity-driven deforestation: South American soy, cocoa from Côte d’Ivoire, Indonesian palm oil, and Brazilian live cattle exports. We show that traders often source more than 40% of commodities “indirectly” via local intermediaries and that indirect sourcing is a major blind spot for sustainable sourcing initiatives. To eliminate deforestation, indirect sourcing must be included in sectoral initiatives, and landscape or jurisdictional approaches, which internalize indirect sourcing, must be scaled up.
abstract_zh: 农产品贸易是全球经济的支柱，但也是造成负面社会和环境影响的主要原因，其中尤以毁林最为突出。大宗商品贸易商是消除毁林努力中的关键行动者：它们活跃于大宗商品的产地，并且是全球贸易中的“关键节点”（pinch point），能够提供强有力的变革杠杆。然而，贸易商的采购策略仍然不透明。本文对四个毁林率较高的行业中贸易商的采购情况进行了编目：南美大豆、科特迪瓦可可、印度尼西亚棕榈油，以及巴西活牛出口。我们发现，贸易商经常通过当地中间商“间接”采购超过40%的大宗商品，而间接采购是可持续采购倡议的一个重大盲区。要消除毁林，就必须将间接采购纳入行业倡议，并扩大能够内部化间接采购的景观或辖区层面方法的应用。

title: Demystifying the numbers behind agriculture-driven tropical deforestation
Mapping and monitoring zero-deforestation commitments
abstract: A growing number of companies have announced zero-deforestation commitments (ZDCs) to eliminate commodities produced at the expense of forests from their supply chains. Translating these aspirational goals into forest conservation requires forest mapping and monitoring (M&M) systems that are technically adequate and therefore credible, salient so that they address the needs of decision makers, legitimate in that they are fair and unbiased, and scalable over space and time. We identify 12 attributes of M&M that contribute to these goals and assess how two prominent ZDC programs, the Amazon Soy Moratorium and the High Carbon Stock Approach, integrate these attributes into their M&M systems. These programs prioritize different attributes, highlighting fundamental trade-offs in M&M design. Rather than prescribe a one-size-fits-all solution, we provide policymakers and practitioners with guidance on the design of ZDC M&M systems that fit their specific use case and that may contribute to more effective implementation of ZDCs.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的企业宣布了零毁林承诺（ZDCs），以将以牺牲森林为代价生产的大宗商品排除在其供应链之外。要将这些理想化目标转化为森林保护成果，就需要技术上足够充分因而可信、对决策者的需求具有针对性、公平且无偏、并能在空间和时间上扩展的森林制图与监测（M&M）系统。我们识别出有助于实现上述目标的12项森林制图与监测属性，并评估了两个主要的零毁林承诺项目——亚马逊大豆禁令（Amazon Soy Moratorium）和高碳储量方法（High Carbon Stock Approach）——如何将这些属性纳入其制图与监测体系。这两个项目侧重的属性不同，凸显了制图与监测设计中的根本性权衡。我们并不提供一刀切的解决方案，而是为政策制定者和实践者提供指导，帮助其设计符合自身具体应用场景的零毁林承诺制图与监测系统，从而可能促进零毁林承诺的更有效落实。

title: Analogies for a No-Analog World: Tackling Uncertainties in Species Reintroductions
Brazil's Amazon Soy Moratorium reduced deforestation
Deforestation Spillovers from Oil Palm Sustainability Certification
abstract: Environmental policies that impose restrictions within one location may be undermined or reinforced by ‘spillover effects,’ the movement of actors, processes, or knowledge to other locations. Such spillovers are an important consideration in the design of interventions seeking to reduce commodity driven deforestation. In these settings, global markets and mobile actors can move deforestation and conservation behaviors over large distances, complicating efforts to measure and manage spillovers. Here we quantify forest loss and conservation spillovers from the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) certification system in Indonesian Borneo (Kalimantan). We examine whether spillovers from certification are transmitted through corporate groups (i.e. to non-certified, RSPO member-held plantations) or local agricultural markets (i.e. to lands near certified mills). We find that, from 2009 to 2016, spillovers from RSPO certification reduced deforestation within Indonesia’s forest estate, but increased deforestation in areas zoned for agricultural use. The private RSPO certification system has complemented public conservation by aligning de facto land cover with central government land zoning policy. Despite these benefits, aggregate avoided deforestation attributed to direct and spillover effects was statistically and substantively insignificant when compared to the total deforestation occurring inside all of Kalimantan’s oil palm concessions. While certification has reduced illegal deforestation, stronger sector-wide action appears necessary to ensure that oil palm production is no longer a driver of forest loss.
abstract_zh: 在一地施加限制的环境政策，可能会因“溢出效应”而被削弱或强化，所谓溢出效应是指行为主体、过程或知识向其他地点的转移。此类溢出效应是设计旨在减少大宗商品驱动毁林的干预措施时的一个重要考量。在这些情境中，全球市场和流动的行为主体可以将毁林和保护行为转移到很远的距离，从而使衡量和管理溢出效应的努力变得复杂。本文量化了印度尼西亚婆罗洲（加里曼丹）可持续棕榈油圆桌倡议（RSPO）认证体系所带来的森林损失和保护溢出效应。我们考察了认证的溢出效应是否通过企业集团（即传导至未认证的、由RSPO成员持有的种植园）或当地农产品市场（即传导至经认证加工厂附近的土地）进行传递。我们发现，在2009年至2016年间，RSPO认证的溢出效应减少了印度尼西亚森林资源范围内的毁林，但增加了规划用于农业用途地区的毁林。私营的RSPO认证体系通过使事实上的土地覆盖与中央政府的土地区划政策保持一致，对公共保护形成了补充。尽管有这些益处，但与加里曼丹所有油棕特许经营地内发生的总毁林量相比，直接效应和溢出效应合计所避免的毁林量，在统计上和实质上都微不足道。虽然认证减少了非法毁林，但要确保棕榈油生产不再成为森林损失的驱动因素，似乎仍需要整个行业采取更强有力的行动。

title: Does Oil Palm Certification Create Trade-Offs between Environment and Development in Indonesia?
abstract: Environmental and social problems triggered by rapid palm oil expansion in the tropics have spurred the proliferation of sustainability certification systems such as the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO). While the RSPO aims to improve the impact of oil palm production on people and environments, its effect on local development, environmental quality, and, especially, potential trade-offs between these outcomes remain unclear. Here, we evaluate whether RSPO certification of large-scale industrial concessions has promoted village development and supported environmental quality in Indonesia, the top global palm oil producer. Using a panel dataset with observations from 11 000 villages in Kalimantan and Sumatra from 2003 to 2014, we apply rigorous quasi-experimental methods to quantify the RSPO’s impacts on village development and environmental outcomes. In the short-run, RSPO contributed to environmental conservation, but had limited development outcomes. On average, relative to villages with non-certified concessions, RSPO certification reduced deforestation and protected primary forests in Sumatra and lowered the incidence of village-reported land pollution in Kalimantan. RSPO certification also increased the number of private educational facilities in Kalimantan, but had no statistically significant impacts on other development indicators. However, the trade-offs and complementarities between conservation and development vary by slope, a proxy for ecosystem fragility and oil palm profitability. On gentler slopes, we generally find complementarities between conservation and development outcomes. In Kalimantan, certification increased the number of private educational facilities and reduced deforestation and the incidence of land pollution on slopes < 2°. In Sumatra, certification retained more primary forests, decreased deforestation and the incidence of water pollution on slopes < 1°, along with a decrease in population density. Higher slopes in both locations were associated with environment and development trade-offs. We highlight the need to better understand the mechanisms behind the impacts of RSPO and emphasized how the outcomes of certification depend on the communities’ bargaining power and the profitability of the land for oil palm production. Thus, we provide insights into understanding these mechanisms behind the impacts of RSPO, which is a prerequisite for improving the design of certification systems and their impacts on the ground.
abstract_zh: 热带地区棕榈油的快速扩张引发了一系列环境和社会问题，这推动了诸如可持续棕榈油圆桌倡议（RSPO）等可持续认证体系的兴起。尽管RSPO旨在改善油棕生产对人类和环境的影响，但其对地方发展、环境质量的作用，尤其是这些结果之间潜在的权衡关系，仍不清楚。本文评估了对大型工业特许经营地的RSPO认证是否促进了印度尼西亚（全球最大的棕榈油生产国）的村庄发展并支持了环境质量。利用2003至2014年间加里曼丹和苏门答腊11000个村庄的面板数据集，我们运用严格的准实验方法，量化了RSPO对村庄发展和环境结果的影响。短期来看，RSPO促进了环境保护，但发展成效有限。平均而言，与拥有未认证特许经营地的村庄相比，RSPO认证减少了苏门答腊的毁林并保护了原始森林，并降低了加里曼丹村庄报告的土地污染发生率。RSPO认证还增加了加里曼丹私立教育设施的数量，但对其他发展指标没有统计上显著的影响。然而，保护与发展之间的权衡和互补关系因坡度而异，坡度可作为生态系统脆弱性和油棕盈利能力的代理指标。在较平缓的坡地上，我们总体上发现保护与发展结果之间存在互补关系。在加里曼丹，认证增加了私立教育设施的数量，并在坡度小于2°的地块上减少了毁林和土地污染的发生率。在苏门答腊，认证保留了更多的原始森林，并在坡度小于1°的地块上减少了毁林和水污染的发生率，同时人口密度也有所下降。两地较陡的坡地都与环境和发展之间的权衡相关。我们强调，有必要更好地理解RSPO影响背后的机制，并指出认证结果取决于社区的议价能力以及土地用于油棕生产的盈利能力。因此，我们为理解RSPO影响背后的机制提供了见解，而这正是改进认证体系设计及其实际效果的前提。

title: Impacts of Chilean Forest Subsidies on Forest Extent, Carbon and Biodiversity
Managing Uncertainty in Carbon Offsets: Insights from California's Standardized Approach
abstract: Carbon offsets allow greenhouse gas emitters to comply with an emissions cap by paying others outside of the capped sectors to reduce emissions. The first major carbon offset programme, the United Nations’ Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), has been criticized for generating a large number of credits from projects that do not actually reduce emissions. Following the controversial CDM experience, California pioneered a second-generation compliance offset programme that shifts the focus of quality control from assessments of individual projects to the development of offset protocols, which define project type-specific eligibility criteria and methods for estimating emissions reductions. We assess the ability of California’s ‘standardized approach’ to mitigate the risk of over-crediting greenhouse gas reductions by reviewing the development of two California offset protocols – Mine Methane Capture and Rice Cultivation. We examine the regulator’s treatment of three sources of over-crediting under the CDM: non-additional projects, inflated counterfactual baseline scenarios, and perverse incentives that inadvertently increase emissions. We find that the standardized approach offers the ability to reduce, but not eliminate, the risk of over-crediting. This requires careful protocol-scale analysis, conservative methods for estimating reductions, ongoing monitoring of programme outcomes, and restricting participation to project types with manageable levels of uncertainty in emission reductions. However, several of these elements are missing from California’s regime, and even best practices result in significant uncertainty in true emission reductions. Relying on carbon offsets to lower compliance costs risks lessening total emission reductions and increases uncertainty in whether an emissions target has been met. Key policy insights Substantial and ongoing oversight by offset programme administrators is needed to contain uncertainty and avoid over-crediting. California’s Mine Methane Capture Protocol may have influenced federal decisions not to regulate methane emissions from coal mines on federally-owned lands. Government priorities and methodological choices drive outcomes in carbon pricing policies with large offset programmes, contrary to the common perception that these policies delegate decision-making to private actors. Offsets are better understood as a way for regulated emitters to invest in an incentive programme that achieves difficult-to-estimate emission reductions, than as accurately quantified tons of reductions.
abstract_zh: 碳抵消允许温室气体排放者通过支付受控行业之外的他方减少排放，来履行排放上限义务。第一个大型碳抵消项目——联合国清洁发展机制（CDM）——曾因产生大量并非真正减排项目的信用额而受到批评。在CDM经验的基础上，加利福尼亚率先推行了第二代合规抵消计划，该计划将质量控制的重点从对单个项目的评估转向抵消方法学的制定，后者规定了针对特定项目类型的合格标准以及估算减排量的方法。我们评估了加利福尼亚“标准化方法”在多大程度上能够降低温室气体减排量被高估（过度计入）的风险，为此我们回顾了加利福尼亚两项抵消方法学的制定过程，即煤矿甲烷捕集和水稻种植。我们考察了监管机构对CDM下三类过度计入来源的处理方式：非额外性项目、被夸大的反事实基准情景，以及无意中增加排放的反向激励。我们发现，标准化方法能够降低但无法消除过度计入的风险。这需要审慎的方法学层面分析、保守的减排量估算方法、对项目成效的持续监测，以及将参与限制在减排量不确定性可控的项目类型之内。然而，加利福尼亚的制度缺失了其中若干要素，即便是最佳实践，也会导致真实减排量存在显著的不确定性。依赖碳抵消来降低合规成本，可能会减少总体减排量，并增加判断排放目标是否达成的不确定性。关键政策启示：抵消项目管理机构需要进行实质性的、持续的监管，以控制不确定性并避免过度计入。加利福尼亚的煤矿甲烷捕集方法学可能影响了联邦政府不对联邦所有土地上煤矿甲烷排放进行监管的决定。与人们普遍认为碳定价政策将决策权委托给私人主体的看法相反，在拥有大规模抵消项目的碳定价政策中，政府的优先事项和方法学选择决定了最终结果。抵消更应被理解为受管制排放者投资于一项激励计划的方式，该计划可实现难以估算的减排，而非精确量化的减排吨数。

title: Criteria for Effective Zero-Deforestation Commitments
abstract: Zero-deforestation commitments are a type of voluntary sustainability initiative that companies adopt to signal their intention to reduce or eliminate deforestation associated with commodities that they produce, trade, and/or sell. Because each company defines its own zero-deforestation commitment goals and implementation mechanisms, commitment content varies widely. This creates challenges for the assessment of commitment implementation or effectiveness. Here, we develop criteria to assess the potential effectiveness of zero-deforestation commitments at reducing deforestation within a company supply chain, regionally, and globally. We apply these criteria to evaluate 52 zero-deforestation commitments made by companies identified by Forest 500 as having high deforestation risk. While our assessment indicates that existing commitments converge with several criteria for effectiveness, they fall short in a few key ways. First, they cover just a small share of the global market for deforestation-risk commodities, which means that their global impact is likely to be small. Second, biome-wide implementation is only achieved in the Brazilian Amazon. Outside this region, implementation occurs mainly through certification programs, which are not adopted by all producers and lack third-party near-real time deforestation monitoring. Additionally, around half of all commitments include zero-net deforestation targets and future implementation deadlines, both of which are design elements that may reduce effectiveness. Zero-net targets allow promises of future reforestation to compensate for current forest loss, while future implementation deadlines allow for preemptive clearing. To increase the likelihood that commitments will lead to reduced deforestation across all scales, more companies should adopt zero-gross deforestation targets with immediate implementation deadlines and clear sanction-based implementation mechanisms in biomes with high risk of forest to commodity conversion.
abstract_zh: 零毁林承诺是一类自愿性可持续倡议，企业通过采纳它来表明其意图，即减少或消除与其生产、交易和/或销售的大宗商品相关的毁林。由于每家企业都会设定各自的零毁林承诺目标和实施机制，承诺的内容差异很大，这给评估承诺的落实情况或有效性带来了挑战。本文提出了一套标准，用以评估零毁林承诺在企业供应链内、区域层面以及全球层面减少毁林的潜在有效性。我们运用这些标准，评估了由“Forest 500”认定为毁林风险较高的企业所作的52项零毁林承诺。尽管我们的评估表明，现有承诺在若干有效性标准上趋于一致，但它们在几个关键方面仍有不足。首先，它们仅覆盖了毁林风险大宗商品全球市场的一小部分，这意味着其全球影响可能很小。其次，只有在巴西亚马逊地区才实现了生物群落范围的落实。在该地区以外，落实主要依靠认证项目，而这些认证项目并未被所有生产者采纳，并且缺乏第三方近实时的毁林监测。此外，约一半的承诺包含零净毁林目标以及未来的实施期限，这两项设计要素都可能降低有效性。零净目标允许以未来的再造林来抵消当前的森林损失，而未来的实施期限则可能允许企业提前清除森林。为了提高承诺在各个尺度上减少毁林的可能性，更多企业应当在毁林风险较高的生物群落中，采纳零总量毁林目标、即时实施期限以及明确的基于制裁的实施机制。

title: Testing the benefits of conservation set-asides for improved habitat connectivity in tropical agricultural landscapes
Effect of Oil Palm Sustainability Certification on Deforestation and Fire in Indonesia
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Demand for agricultural commodities is the leading driver of tropical deforestation. Many corporations have pledged to eliminate forest loss from their supply chains by purchasing only certified “sustainable” products. To evaluate whether certification fulfills such pledges, we applied statistical analyses to satellite-based estimates of tree cover loss to infer the causal impact of a third-party certification system on deforestation and fire within Indonesian oil palm plantations. We found that certification significantly reduced deforestation, but not fire or peatland clearance, among participating plantations. Moreover, certification was mostly adopted in older plantations that contained little remaining forest. Broader adoption by oil palm growers is likely needed for certification to have a large impact on total forest area lost to oil palm expansion.
abstract_zh: 农产品需求是热带毁林的首要驱动因素。许多企业承诺，只采购经认证的“可持续”产品，以将森林损失排除在其供应链之外。为评估认证是否履行了这类承诺，我们对基于卫星的林冠损失估计数据进行了统计分析，以推断第三方认证体系对印度尼西亚油棕种植园内毁林和火灾的因果影响。我们发现，认证显著减少了参与认证种植园的毁林，但对火灾或泥炭地清除没有显著影响。此外，认证主要被采纳于残余森林很少的老旧种植园。要使认证对油棕扩张所导致的森林总损失产生重大影响，可能需要油棕种植者更广泛地采纳认证。

title: Inequality and the Biosphere
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources

title: Navigating Novelty and Risk in Resilience Management
The Role of Supply-Chain Initiatives in Reducing Deforestation
A plantation dominated forest transition in Chile
Impacts of Nonstate, Market-Driven Governance on Chilean Forests
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Global trade in commodities has become an important driver of environmental degradation. In response, there has been a proliferation of nonstate, market-driven governance seeking to reduce environmental degradation through interventions in the supply chain. We provide some of the first quasiexperimental evidence to show that private, market-driven policies can slow deforestation. We compare the impacts of two certification schemes and a deforestation moratorium in Chile using a factorial quasiexperimental design. Our results indicate that governance regimes with greater collaboration between environmental and industry stakeholders achieved better environmental outcomes. In contrast to many public conservation policies, we find that private governance systems can effectively target high-deforestation properties.
abstract_zh: 大宗商品的全球贸易已成为环境退化的重要驱动因素。作为回应，以市场为导向的非国家治理日益增多，试图通过对供应链的干预来减少环境退化。我们提供了一些最早的准实验证据，表明私人的、市场驱动的政策能够减缓毁林。我们利用析因准实验设计，比较了智利两种认证计划和一项毁林禁令的影响。研究结果表明，环境利益相关方与产业利益相关方合作程度更高的治理机制，取得了更好的环境成效。与许多公共保护政策不同，我们发现私人治理体系能够有效地瞄准高毁林的产业用地。

title: Land-Use Policies and Corporate Investments in Agriculture in the Gran Chaco and Chiquitano
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: A growing global demand for agricultural products such as soybeans and beef is causing agriculture to expand into forest ecosystems. Many countries are tightening environmental regulations as a response. Because agricultural companies can move, there is a risk that stringent land-use regulations might just displace land conversion geographically. A better understanding of how these regulations affect companies’ movements is therefore crucial for designing effective conservation policies. Here we analyze the determinants of siting choices by agricultural companies. We find that companies that tend to clear more forest prefer areas with lower deforestation restrictions, and that all companies prefer areas with low enforcement. However, these effects are less important than the availability of forestland or the proximity to current investments.
abstract_zh: 全球对大豆和牛肉等农产品日益增长的需求，正促使农业向森林生态系统扩张。许多国家正在收紧环境法规以作回应。由于农业企业可以迁移，严格的土地利用管制可能只是在地理上转移了土地转化。因此，更好地理解这些法规如何影响企业的迁移，对于设计有效的保护政策至关重要。本文分析了农业企业选址选择的决定因素。我们发现，那些倾向于砍伐更多森林的企业更偏好毁林限制较少的地区，而所有企业都偏好执法力度较弱的地区。然而，这些效应的重要性都低于林地的可得性或与现有投资的邻近程度。

title: Conservation through Intensification? The Effects of Plantations on Natural Forests
Effective, efficient or equitable: using allowance allocations to mitigate emissions leakage
abstract: The European Union (EU), the US and Australia have each adopted, or are considering, free allocations to emissions-intensive, trade-exposed industries (EITEIs) in order to minimize emissions leakage and industrial offshoring resulting from climate policy. Differences in the design of these schemes, including how a country defines eligible EITEIs, the scale of allocation and the method of distribution, all have the potential to affect the outcomes of the programmes. In crafting their EITEI allocation formulas, policymakers in each country must balance three important priorities – the economic efficiency of the cap and trade programme, an equitable distribution of the programme's allowances and the effectiveness of the allocations in addressing leakage and competitiveness concerns. These three priorities provide a useful framework for considering the tradeoffs inherent in designing allocation schemes for EITEIs. Through this lens, policy approaches taken by the EU, US and Australia are evaluated with respect to four important questions of allocation policy design: the definition of EITEIs, the costs to be covered, the methodology for distributing allowances and the duration of free allocation.
abstract_zh: 欧盟、美国和澳大利亚已经或正在考虑，对排放密集型、贸易暴露型行业（EITEIs）实行免费配额分配，以最大限度地减少气候政策所导致的排放泄漏和产业外迁。这些计划在设计上的差异，包括各国如何界定符合条件的EITEI行业、分配的规模以及分配方式，都有可能影响计划的结果。在制定EITEI配额分配公式时，各国政策制定者必须平衡三项重要的优先事项：总量控制与交易计划的经济效率、配额分配的公平性，以及分配在应对泄漏和竞争力问题上的有效性。这三项优先事项为权衡EITEI分配方案设计中固有的取舍提供了一个有用的框架。在此视角下，本文从四个关于配额分配政策设计的重要问题出发，对欧盟、美国和澳大利亚所采取的政策方法进行了评估：EITEI的界定、需要覆盖的成本、配额的分配方法，以及免费分配的期限。
